title: Legal Cost Guides: What Lawyers and Courts Cost in the U.S. (2026)
description: What lawyers charge, court filing fees by state, legal fee caps and free legal help in the U.S., with every number linked to its official source.
body:
What legal help really costs in the U.S.

Lawyer rates, court filing fees, legal fee caps and free-help options, explained in plain English, with every number linked to the official source behind it.

How much does a lawyer cost?Find your state

Key numbers, checked October 2026

WhatAmountSource
Average lawyer billed rate (U.S.)$349/hourClio, 2025 data
Filing a federal civil lawsuit$405U.S. Courts
Chapter 7 / Chapter 13 bankruptcy filing$338 / $313U.S. Courts
Social Security disability representative fee cap25% of past-due benefits, max $9,200SSA
Free legal aid income limit (1 person / family of 4, 48 states)$19,950 / $41,250 a yearLSC, Federal Register

How this site works

LegalCostGuides is written by Javi Pérez, an independent researcher who is not a lawyer, so every figure links to the statute, court or agency page it comes from, and gaps are labeled instead of estimated. The site is funded by ads, LawDepot affiliate links and our own planning kits; none of them affects the figures. Read how we research.
